transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I... well. I guess I had to come in. It's just... things at the office. 

I keep hearing... people talking about me. Through the conference room walls. Or sometimes from my phone, even when it's completely turned off. It's usually the board members. Or my staff. They're... they're saying I'm ruining the company. 

I wouldn't even bring it up, but... it sounds so clear. I've actually caught myself answering them back before I realize... no one else in the room heard it. So... that's why I'm here.
During this time, have you been feeling unusually high or energized for days at a time?
No... not really. I don't think I've felt like that. Just... my normal amount of energy, I guess.
How long have you been hearing these voices?
I suppose... maybe about three months? Give or take. That's when I first started noticing them coming through the walls... and the phone. So, yeah. Around three months.
Do you believe these people are actually trying to harm you or sabotage you?
I... I don't know. I haven't really thought about it like that. I'm not sure what they're trying to do. They just... say those things.
Have you found yourself caring much less than usual about things like work, seeing people, or daily activities?

I suppose... yes. It's different now. I used to be the one driving everything... calling people, pushing ideas forward. But lately... I just sit at my desk. I can stare at the agenda for hours. I don't really talk to my staff much anymore... or my husband. I just... don't feel much of anything about the work I used to care about.
Have you noticed your thoughts or speech getting so jumbled that other people have trouble following what you’re saying?
No... I haven't noticed that. I mean... I don't really talk enough right now for anyone to say either way. So... no.
Have you had any recent seizures, head injury, or other major medical illness?
No. Nothing like that. I haven't been sick or hurt.
Do you believe the board members or your staff are deliberately sending you these messages?
...Messages? I don't... no. I don't really know what you mean by that. Nobody is sending me anything.
During the time you've been hearing these voices, have you also had a period of feeling very depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No. I haven't... I haven't been depressed. I'm just... tired, I guess. But not depressed.
Have you felt that your thoughts were being controlled by something outside of you?
No... I don't think so. They're just my thoughts. I don't really know why you would ask that. Nobody is controlling them.
While this has been going on, have you had a period when you felt unusually happy or euphoric?
No... I haven't felt like that. I don't really know why I would be. I'm just... normal, I guess.
Before these last three months, had you ever heard voices like this at any other time in your life?
No. Not before this. Just... recently.
Since the voices started, have there been times when you felt emotionally flat or unable to feel pleasure nearly every day?

I guess so. I just... I don't really feel much of anything lately. I used to love my work. I was always the one driving every idea, calling people after openings... but now, I just sit at my desk for hours. Staring at the agenda. I barely speak to my staff... or my husband. I just don't really care about any of it anymore.
Do you have a strong belief that someone is plotting against you?
No... I don't think so. I haven't noticed anything like that.
During these last three months, have there been times when you felt hopeless or worthless nearly every day?
No... not really. I wouldn't say hopeless. Just... empty, I suppose.
Aside from hearing the voices, have you had a fixed belief that something unusual is true even though other people say it isn’t?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really had any thoughts like that. Just the voices.
Since the voices began, have you had a time when you felt depressed nearly all day, almost every day?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt depressed like that. Just... no.
Compared with before this started, have you been functioning worse at work or at home?

Yes. It's... it's been difficult. I can't really keep up at work anymore. Making decisions for the division... I just can't. The senior staff have been doing most of it now. And at home... my husband does everything. I just... I don't finish things. Or I don't start them.
Have you started using any drugs or medications around the time the voices began?
No... I haven't taken anything like that. No drugs. And I didn't start any new medications, either. Just... no.
Have you felt that outside forces are putting thoughts into your mind?
No... I don't think so. No one is putting things in my head. They're just... my own thoughts.
